versions.content: For PXX = P04m, P07m, P08m and P44m: the function E2EXf_ Inv_<transformerId> on the server-side shall invoke E2E_PXXSinkCheck(), passing to that function: • config, • state, • the local variables messageType, messageResult, and the address of the local variable sourceID • data length: inputBufferLength - EndToEndTransformationDescription.upper HeaderBitsToShift • pointer to data:  inputBuffer + EndToEndTransformationDescription.upperHeaderBitsToShift (out-of-place version) or  buffer + EndToEndTransformationDescription.upperHeaderBitsToShift (in- place version).
